scope: Live partial diagnostics, not final round archive
snapshot_method: Byte-for-byte selected JSONL records with original LF; gzip deterministic
limitations: Scan-window subset cannot replay prior complete map/body-proof or actual callback timing
Current occupied footprint cannot be made free by unknown body proof
Truth used only offline diagnosis; not sent to control
replay_method: For each navigation scan_window restore recorded nonfinite kinds, feed actual ObservedMap with original scan and pose timestamps. Query original grid inflation offsets radius1.2 + resolution/2 and report recent100 cells, plus actual local_command_clear at zero velocity. No previous body proof, full-map history or movement callback replay.
